listing.name: Paranoia Scape — Paranoia Scape Recompiled (LevonFrench)
listing.summary: This early build is reported to boot and reach gameplay. Full-game compatibility is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese SLPS01375 BIN/CUE with all 13 tracks. Apply the optional Aeon Genesis English patch only if you are permitted to use it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the release executable to complete first-time setup locally with its portable compiler and OpenBIOS.

warnings: This early build is reported to boot and reach gameplay. Full-game compatibility is unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
